title: MacOS testsuite errors
body:
Fix two errors in the test suite, one that only appears on MacOS, one that appears one some other architures, too.

* test_movie in the GUI tests fails because some race condition causes the frame number to be wrong.  It does not happen in actual usage, where a window is open, but apparently happens on Mac where windows are not shown during testing.
* Increased tolerance of an MD test where different numerical noise cause the test to fail on some hardware.

comments.body:
Thank you so much @schiotz for the MR!

Regarding the `test_movie` failure, I believe !3697 has solved the issue, so I rebased the MR without this part.

Regarding `test_melchionna_lower_tri`, while I do not usually see issues with my Apple Silicon MacOS, it would be not bad to use a moderate criterion, so I would like to merge now.
